maya: flagging a small but sticky UX regression: when users pin a model version in compact compare, the filter row wraps and CLS spikes on page load. Loom: https://loom.example/pin-cls. Can we discuss fixes? sam: seen it. On mobile it's worse 1% increase in reported layout shift in last release. we should avoid any vertical shift when toggling pin. jordan: quick options: 1) reserve fixed toolbar height, show clipped pills with ellipsis; 2) move the pin control into header meta (less discoverable); 3) float the pin as a compact chip that overlays but doesn't push content. maya: +1 for reserving height. overlay chips feel hacky and could conflict with tooltips. alex: from a visual hierarchy POV, perf badges are too attention-grabbing right now. propose tone-down tokens: borderless outline + 12px label instead of 14px bold. we keep color for regressions only. ana: copy test idea: "Lock version" vs "Pin version" vs "Freeze compare". which is clearest? suggest A/B testing copy for 2 weeks. rui: accessibility: if we clip pills, ensure overflow button is keyboard-focusable, has aria-expanded, and the popover uses role=listbox with aria-activedescendant for keyboard nav. also add aria-atomic to live region for badge updates. lee-pm: analytics ask: can we instrument events so we can measure success? e.g., track catalog.pin_toggled, catalog.overflow_opened, and CLS delta per session. Goal: reduce CLS by 0.15 in 2 weeks and increase pin retention by 10%. sam: tech note: reserving toolbar height is low-risk CSS. example: `.toolbar { min-height: 48px; } .pills { max-width: calc(100% - 140px); }` That leaves space for a sticky pin area. jordan: for the overflow UI, propose showing hidden filters in the same order as rail, include counts, and support Shift+Tab to jump back to filters list. alex: tooltip behavior: use longpress on mobile to reveal badge details; on desktop hover/focus shows description. Need a11y text alternatives for icons. ana: copy variants for pin menu: ["Pin v2.3 (Strict)", "Pin v2.3 (Allow fallbacks)", "Pin v2.3 1: Auto-fallback to cheaper tier"]. Also propose short helper: "Pinned views freeze metric snapshots. Toggle Live to refresh." rui: reduced-motion: when collapsing pills to overflow, avoid width/height transitions for users with prefers-reduced-motion. use cross-fade instead. maya: plan proposal: 1) reserve toolbar height + implement +N overflow (dev). 2) pin UI moves to the right sticky slot with version + policy menu (design). 3) badge de-emphasis token + regressions highlighted (design). 4) analytics instrumentation as lee requested (eng+pm). 5) A/B copy test for pin language (growth). 6) accessibility checklist updates (rui). sam: I'll spin up a small PR for the CSS change and add unit test for keyboard nav. estimate: 2 dev days. jordan: I'll mock 2 variants in figma: fixed-height toolbar vs overlay pin. linking: https://www.figma.com/file/compact-compare-overflow. ale: (typo) meant alex: I'll prepare the badge token PR and color delta specs. rui: I'll draft aria snippets and paste examples in accessibility doc. quick example for live badge: `
Latency: 32ms
`. lee-pm: setting success criteria and experiment windows. I'll schedule a 2-week rollout to 10% of sessions and measure CLS + pin retention. maya: thanks team. small follow-up: make sure the overflow count excludes pinned chips and that the +N label reads properly for screen readers ("Show 3 hidden filters"). sam: noted, will implement counting logic. jordan: :shipit: rui: :white_check_mark: ale: :thumbsup:
